# Blacure

> Blacure is The Promptor — an AI song prompt generator that builds polished, studio-grade music prompts from genre, vocals, mood, topic, instruments, tempo, and style.

Blacure helps producers, songwriters, and hobbyists craft prompts for AI music tools (Suno, Udio, and similar). Users pick from curated dropdowns covering hip-hop, R&B, trap, soul, gospel, Afrobeat, pop, house, cinematic, and more, then generate or randomize a complete prompt ready to paste into their music workflow.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing Blacure and The Promptor.
- [The Promptor](/app): Interactive prompt builder with genre, vocals, mood, instruments, tempo, and style controls.
